Name: CinderTap
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
Adds tap-to-move navigation for PC and Cinderbox, with enhanced features like drag-to-queue actions and auto-combat.

[i]If you use [color=#f1c232][b]Cinderbox[/b][/color], this is a part of the [b]Cinderbox Pack[/b] file that can be downloaded during setup and on the Home screen.[/i]

[line]

[center][youtube]y32HU_RNamU[/youtube][/center]

[color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Tap or click on a tile to move.[/*]
[*]Tool auto-swapping.[/*]
[*]Auto-combat for melee weapons and slingshot.[/*]
[*]Drag-to-queue for machines, crops, and watering.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Setup[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Open the in-game options.[/*]
[*]In the dropdown labeled Control Style, select [b]Tap to Move[/b] to enable it.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]PC[/b]: Download the file and extract it into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*][b]Cinderbox[/b]: This is a part of the [b]Cinderbox Pack[/b] file that can be downloaded during setup and on the Home screen. You don't need to download from here.[/*]
[/list]
